name: 02. Factions: The Horde of the Rotting Hand

text.content:
The Horde of the Rotting Hand

Referee's Note: The internal structure of the Horde is unknown to the inhabitants of Middenmark. Player characters should uncover these alliances, rivalries, and weaknesses through interrogation, espionage, and dungeon exploration.

The Horde of the Rotting Hand is a loose confederation of humanoid tribes, desert raiders, and monstrous brutes united under the dark priesthood of Impurax (God of Corruption, Rot, and Decay) and the undead sorcerers known as the Archons of the Trium. Their ultimate goal is to amass enough biological decay, sacrificial victims, and arcane energy at the Great Henge to gate an aspect of Impurax onto the Material Plane.

The Structure of the Rotting Hand

The priesthood of Impurax organizes the Horde into symbolic appendages of a diseased hand, assigning specific tactical roles to each group:

  • The Palm (Command & Cult): The Priesthood of Impurax and the Archons of the Trium, operating out of the Great Henge (Area M) and the deeper Archaian levels. Enforced by the Fanged Legion (fanatical human cultist-warriors) and Black Orcs.
  • The Thumb (Heavy Shock Troops): Ogres, Trolls, Hill Giants, and Minotaurs (including Tricerotaurs). Used as battering rams in major caravan raids and kept in reserve to crush internal tribal rebellions.
  • The Index Finger (Scouts & Perimeter): Red Tail Kobolds (Area A) and Hopping Death Froglings (Area B). Assigned to guard the upper canyon entrances, maintain early-warning traps, and scavenge the outer ruins.
  • The Middle Finger (Raiders & Infantry): Bloodied Hand Goblins (Area C), Black Tusk Orcs (Area D), and Dervish Raiders (Area E). Form the bulk of the Horde's raiding parties across the Forbidden Zone and Middenmark borderlands.
  • The Ring Finger (Elite Warriors & Slavers): Iron Fist Hobgoblins (Area F) and Bonechewer Gnolls (Area G). Disciplined mercenaries and brutal slavers responsible for capturing living sacrifices for the Great Henge.
  • The Pinky Finger (Outcasts & Irregulars): Mudscale Lizardmen (Area H), Skullcrusher Bugbears (Area I), and Cave Neanderthals (Area J). Fiercely territorial tribes that resent Impurite oversight and frequently skirmish with rival Horde factions.

Tribes of the Archaia Canyons

Each major tribe occupies a fortified complex within the canyon walls or sunken ruins of Archaia. Smart parties can exploit their mutual hatreds to turn one tribe against another.

Area Tribe / Faction Leader(s) Banner / Emblem Primary Goals & Leverage
Area A Red Tail Kobolds Chieftain Yip-Yip & Shaman Snik Red-dyed rat tail on a spear Cowardly trap-makers; bullied by the Froglings (Area B) and Goblins (Area C). Will gladly betray neighbors if bribed or intimidated.
Area B Hopping Death Froglings Chief Croak-Gash Impaled giant toad Territorial ambushers guarding the watery sinkholes; despise the Kobolds and Lizardmen.
Area C Bloodied Hand Goblins King Gorgut Crimson handprint on black hide Bitter rivals of the Black Tusk Orcs (Area D). Seek to expand their territory into Area A and Area D.
Area D Black Tusk Orcs Warlord Kragash Blackened boar tusk Aggressive raiders led by a brutal warlord; resent Hobgoblin discipline and constantly raid Goblin patrols.
Area E Dervish Raiders Sheikh Al-Zahir Scimitar & twin suns Human desert nomads allied with the Horde purely for plunder and slaves; pragmatic and open to gold bribes.
Area F Iron Fist Hobgoblins Warlord Vorgath Iron gauntlet Militaristic enforcers of the Horde; despise chaotic tribes (Goblins, Gnolls, Bugbears) and value martial honor.
Area G Bonechewer Gnolls Packlord Yeenog-Fang Split humanoid femur Sadistic slavers and hyena-breeders; allied with Bugbears in slave-trading, hated by nearly everyone else.
Area H Mudscale Lizardmen Shaman-King Sssarath Crocodile skull Isolationist swamp/subterranean dwellers; tolerate Neanderthals, hostile to warm-blooded raiders.
Area I Skullcrusher Bugbears Chieftain Grumsh-Skull Cracked dwarf skull Ambush predators and slave brokers; fiercely hostile toward Hobgoblins and Orcs.
Area J Cave Neanderthals Elder Korg Sabre-tooth fang Primitive, stubborn clan; only friendly with Lizardmen, deeply suspicious of magic-users and Impurites.
Area K–M Cult of Impurax & Fanged Legion High Priest Malakor & The Archons Rotting green hand Fanatical leadership orchestrating the Great Henge ritual; absolute enemies of all surface dwellers.

Tribal Relations Matrix & Reaction Modifiers

When two Horde patrols meet in the canyons (see Table 4.1) or when PCs disguise themselves, carry tribal banners, or negotiate between factions, consult the matrix below and apply the corresponding 2d6 Reaction Roll modifier:

  • Ally (+3 to Reaction): Actively cooperate, share intelligence, and combine forces against intruders.
  • Friendly (+1 to Reaction): Trade goods/slaves peacefully and honor safe passage unless provoked.
  • Neutral (0 to Reaction): Wary coexistence; will ignore each other unless one side appears weak or carries valuable loot.
  • Hostile (-2 to Reaction): Frequent border skirmishes, raids, and theft; will attack if they hold a 2-to-1 numerical advantage.
  • Enemy (-4 to Reaction): Kill on sight; bitter blood feuds that override orders from the Priesthood of Impurax.
